description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity called HelloEffects. It implements a media effects app that applies various visual effects to an image using OpenGL ES 2.0 and Android's Effect API. The class manages texture loading, effect creation, and rendering logic, offering a menu to select different effects.

classes.name: HelloEffects
classes.description: An Android activity that applies various image effects to a texture displayed via OpenGL ES. Manages textures, effect creation, and rendering pipeline.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the current effect to be applied based on user selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and prepares GLSurfaceView for rendering effects.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates textures, loads an image resource into a texture, and sets texture parameters.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Creates and configures the selected image effect based on current choice.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the created effect to the source texture, rendering into a second texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Displays the processed texture, or falls back to the original if no effect is selected.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Main rendering loop; initializes resources once, applies effects if selected, and renders the final output.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts view size in the renderer when surface dimensions change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Placeholder for any setup needed when the GL surface is created.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with effect choices.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections to change the current effect and request rendering.
